# Add high-level wrappers for export_segment, checkpoint, yieldResult

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary
- Rename low-level ecalli function `export_` → `export_segment` for clarity
- Add `RefineContext.exportSegment(BytesBlob)` → `ResultN<u32, ExportSegmentError>` (wraps ecalli 7)
- Add `AccumulateContext.checkpoint()` → `i64` and `AccumulateContext.yieldResult(Bytes32)` → `void` (wraps ecalli 17, 25)
- Add `TestExportSegment` mock helper with configurable return value
- 4 new unit tests covering success + error paths

## Test plan
- [x] All 140 SDK tests pass (4 new in `context.test.ts`)
- [x] All 46 example tests pass (all-ecalli, ecalli-test, authorizer, fibonacci)
- [x] Pre-push hook (biome lint + full build + PVM compile) passes

## Walkthrough

This PR renames the `export_` host-call to `export_segment` throughout the SDK, examples, and mocks while maintaining the same parameter and return types. It introduces three new context wrapper methods: `RefineContext.exportSegment()` for exporting segments with error handling for export limits, `AccumulateContext.checkpoint()` for creating state checkpoints, and `AccumulateContext.yieldResult()` for providing accumulation result hashes. A new `ExportSegmentError` enum with a `Full` variant is added for export limit signaling, and mock override capabilities are introduced via `setExportSegmentResult()` for testing the error path.

## Possibly related PRs

- **PR `#60`**: Introduces the underlying host-call bindings (checkpoint, yield_result) that form the foundation for the new `AccumulateContext` methods in this PR.
- **PR `#71`**: Refactors the same context classes (`sdk/jam/refine/context.ts`, `sdk/jam/accumulate/context.ts`) that receive the new method additions in this PR.
- **PR `#63`**: Addresses the same `export_` → `export_segment` rename across dispatch and export functionality in the codebase.

## Comment by @coderabbitai[bot]

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_

**Handle non-`FULL` negative sentinels before casting to `u32`.**

At Line 50, any unexpected negative sentinel is currently converted into a success value via `u32(result)`. This can silently corrupt control flow.



<details>
<summary>🔧 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
   exportSegment(segment: BytesBlob): ResultN<u32, ExportSegmentError> {
     const result = export_segment(segment.ptr(), segment.length);
     if (result === EcalliResult.FULL) {
       return ResultN.err<u32, ExportSegmentError>(ExportSegmentError.Full);
     }
-    return ResultN.ok<u32, ExportSegmentError>(u32(result));
+    if (result >= 0) {
+      return ResultN.ok<u32, ExportSegmentError>(u32(result));
+    }
+    panic("RefineContext.exportSegment: unexpected sentinel");
+    return unreachable();
   }
```
</details>

As per coding guidelines `sdk/**/*.ts`: panic is reserved for host-contract violations, while expected failures should use `Result`/`Optional`.

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
  exportSegment(segment: BytesBlob): ResultN<u32, ExportSegmentError> {
    const result = export_segment(segment.ptr(), segment.length);
    if (result === EcalliResult.FULL) {
      return ResultN.err<u32, ExportSegmentError>(ExportSegmentError.Full);
    }
    if (result >= 0) {
      return ResultN.ok<u32, ExportSegmentError>(u32(result));
    }
    panic("RefineContext.exportSegment: unexpected sentinel");
    return unreachable();
  }
```

</details>
